title: Figma CLI plan access token: a fixed-scope category whose carrier is not stated
summary: A Figma CLI plan access token given to the Figma CLI, in an argument, a variable or a configuration file.
rationale: Claims cli-token-creation-fixed-scope-plan-wide and cli-token-lifecycle-shared-with-plan-tokens record a fixed-scope, plan-wide, administrator-created token that shares the refresh and revoke rules of the plan token kind. The plan tokens page says CLI tokens are not general-purpose REST API tokens, so the X-Figma-Token statement made for the Figma API is not read as covering them (open question cli-token-carrier-unstated); the only CLI carrier Figma documents, --token and FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN (claim code-connect-cli-carrier-documented-for-personal-token), is for a personal access token and the page does not mention CLI plan tokens. No independent grammar is stated (cli-token-lexical-shape-unstated), the era of the category is not stated (cli-token-era) and the codebase-upload workflow is undocumented (cli-token-codebase-uploads-undocumented). Contract claims cited: cli-plan-access-token/cli-token-creation-fixed-scope-plan-wide, cli-plan-access-token/code-connect-cli-carrier-documented-for-personal-token.

expectation.rationale: No outcome is asserted. Settled by: a Figma page that states how a Figma CLI plan token is supplied to the CLI.

sources.supports: Go to https://www.figma.com/developers/tokens and select the Figma CLI tab. ... Figma CLI tokens use a fixed scope set and plan-wide authorization, so there are no scope or resource-selection steps.

Generate a personal access token with the Code Connect scope set to Write and the File content scope set to Read. ... Optionally, you can use the FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable to pass your personal access token to the Code Connect command line tool.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
